name: CR-104 Demo: Platform-Mandatory Pack
description: CR-104 validation fixture — Platform-scoped, installation_classification 'Mandatory'. Composes into every Template's EBM automatically, with no Template ever having to list it as a mandatory Pack. Deliberately contributes nothing (no authority rules, quality gates, or policies) so it is safe to leave Mandatory platform-wide: commission any SEU and confirm this Pack appears in its EBM's composed_packs without ever having been selected.
